data.one_liner: Generates deterministic multicultural SVG avatars from a string.
data.what_it_does: Converts an input string into a unique SVG avatar using the Multiavatar algorithm. Supports optional transparent background and works entirely on‑device without network calls.
use_when: You need deterministic, unique avatars for users or identicons without a backend
You want a lightweight, pure‑Dart solution that works on all Flutter platforms
avoid_when: You require raster image formats or built‑in widget rendering
You need extensive customization beyond the preset avatar styles
strengths: Deterministic output for the same input
weaknesses: Only provides raw SVG code, not a ready‑made widget
Relies on the crypto package for hashing
data.minimal_example:
var svg = multiavatar('X-SLAYER');
var svgTransparent = multiavatar('X-SLAYER', trBackground: true);
